title: Hearthhold, the Wardens' capital
changes: The Wardens' walled capital Hearthhold can now be visited: its keep, market, barracks and Oath Hall, with guards and townsfolk about.

The Lord-Marshal pays out your rank rewards, the Keeper of the Oath lets you swear to the Wardens and make Hearthhold your home, and the drillmaster resets your skills and stats at a discount for the sworn.
Sworn Wardens pay 10 percent less at the quartermaster. Study the war table in the keep to open the big map on the war layer.
The maps mark the city gate at Goldenreach Farms.
